title: Deep Hold
summary: Start: enter Deep Hold. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Den Keeper. Do: come within 320 meters of the Den Keeper. The keeper slides alongside and names the hidden dock. The outer rock is the lie. Finish: after the keeper is met, come inside Hollow Rock's shell. Black Sail heat rises. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
